title: Social Analyzer output
description: Profiles found for each username, one row each with confidence, category and country of the site, plus a run summary.

profiles.title: Profiles found (dataset)
profiles.description: One row per matched profile: username, platform, site, link, confidence (high/medium/low), matchRate, category, categoryDetail, country, adultSite, siteRank, pageTitle, pageText, language, metadata (meta tags of confident profiles), extracted, checkedAt. Every run checks all 999 sites unless narrowed. Rows arrive step by step, about 250 sites at a time, and each step is charged when its rows are delivered. The last row (recordType = summary) holds the run totals, sites with no profile, sites that did not answer, and per-username notes.

summary.title: Run summary (JSON)
summary.description: While the run is going this record holds status 'running', percentDone and per-username progress, refreshed after every step of about 250 sites. When the run ends it becomes the full summary: status 'finished', totals, filters, settings used, per-username results, notes, and the plain-language message also shown as the run status.

log.title: Run log
log.description: What was checked, per username, with timings and any scanner warnings.
